top_signals.title: India Seeks Sunflower Oil Alternatives on Black Sea Disruptions
top_signals.summary: India, the world’s top sunflower oil buyer, is rushing to secure supplies of alternate vegetable oils as attacks in the Black Sea region disrupt imports and its own crops falter due to weak monsoon rains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Qatar Sends First LNG Shipment Through Hormuz in Three Weeks
top_signals.summary: Qatar has sent its first shipment of liquefied natural gas through the Strait of Hormuz since one of its tankers was attacked in the waterway more than three weeks ago.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patient information with third-party platforms
top_signals.summary: Popular telehealth provider Hims & Hers "shared consumers’ sensitive health information with third-party advertising platforms such as Meta and Snap despite promising to protect patient privacy," the federal government alleges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
